numeral.purpose: Mastered-verb count; result score runs larger at clamp(5rem, 22vw, 8rem).

headline.purpose: Prompt word on a question screen; gap sentences use 600 at clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 1.9rem).

title.purpose: Section headings above ruled lists; screen titles at 1.8rem.

row-title.purpose: Name in a ruled list row.

label.purpose: Field labels and form captions, pencil grey.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Floating pill controls over the scrolling verb table and the read-aloud stage only.

shadows.name: focus-marker
shadows.purpose: Text field focus; other elements use outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y).

motion.name: swipe
motion.purpose: Highlighter swipe left to right; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Progress bar width (.4s), row arrow nudge (.2s), disclosure icon rotation (.25s).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press scale on buttons (.98), options (.97) and listen buttons (.92).

breakpoints.name: narrow-strip
breakpoints.purpose: Level strip drops from 35 to 14 columns, cells 16px tall.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); background: var(--ink, #1d2433); color: var(--paper, #f8f9fb); font: 700 1.1rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary half of a button pair.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1d2433); font: 700 1.1rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Ruled List Row
components.description: Drill menu row under a 2px ink rule; title gets the yellow marker on hover/press.
components.css: .ds-list { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 72px; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); padding: 14px 4px; color: var(--ink, #1d2433); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-item > span { flex: 1; } .ds-item b { font-size: 1.22rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.015em; padding: 0 .16em; margin: 0 -.16em; border-radius: .14em .4em .2em .36em; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-sub { display: block; color: var(--muted, #525b6d); font-size: .92rem; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-item svg { transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-item:hover b, .ds-item:focus-visible b, .ds-item:active b { background: var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); } .ds-item:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Quick-select group chip; selected takes marker yellow.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip">be – grow</button> <button class="ds-chip ds-on">hang out – sleep</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2433); font: 600 .92rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip.ds-on { background: var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: Multiple-choice answer; graded green (right) or pink (wrong).
components.css: .ds-opts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; } .ds-opt { min-height: 72px; padding: 16px 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2433); font: 700 1.2rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-opt:hover { background: var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); } .ds-opt:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-opt:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); } .ds-opt.ds-ok { background: var(--hl-g, #86eeb4); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); } .ds-opt.ds-bad { background: var(--hl-p, #ffa3c4); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Answer field with label; yellow ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { display: block; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted, #525b6d); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; font: 600 1.3rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1d2433); background: var(--sheet, #fff); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); border-radius: 12px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow .15s ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Theme switch; active segment is marker yellow.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2433); padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 44px; font: 600 .95rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); font-weight: 700; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); outline-offset: -5px; }

components.name: Highlighter Swipe
components.description: Signature: marker stroke drawn left to right behind a word on right answers, solutions and the line read aloud.
components.html: Richtig! Noch nicht ganz.
components.css: .ds-fb { font: 800 1.35rem "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #1d2433); } .ds-mark { --mk: var(--hl-g, #86eeb4); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); background: linear-gradient(var(--mk), var(--mk)) no-repeat 0 72% / 100% 80%; padding: 0 .14em; margin: 0 -.04em; border-radius: .06em .22em .1em .18em; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-mark.ds-p { --mk: var(--hl-p, #ffa3c4); } .ds-swipe { animation: ds-swipe .55s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-swipe:hover { animation-name: ds-swipe2; } @keyframes ds-swipe { from { background-size: 0 80%; color: var(--ink, #1d2433); } 40% { color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); } to { background-size: 100% 80%; } } @keyframes ds-swipe2 { from { background-size: 0 80%; } to { background-size: 100% 80%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-swipe { animation: none; } }

components.name: Listen Button
components.description: 44px ink-outlined circle with a speaker line icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-say" aria-label="Anhören"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 9.5h3.5L12 5.5v13l-4.5-4H4z"/><path d="M15.5 9a4.2 4.2 0 0 1 0 6M18.3 6.5a8 8 0 0 1 0 11"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-say { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1d2433); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1d2433); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-say:active { transform: scale(.92); background: var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); color: var(--on-hl, #1d2433); } .ds-say:focus-visible { outline: 5px solid var(--hl-y, #f6ea4f); }

narrative.overview:
The app is the student's own exercise book. The page is fine squared paper, everything is written in one fineliner ink (a deep navy), and colour appears only where a highlighter would go: on the current thing, on the right answer, on the wrong one. Structure comes from ruled lines and inked boxes, never from tinted cards. The result reads grown-up and calm for a 12+ learner while staying warm, because the highlighter swipe is the one gesture that moves.

Density is relaxed: one question per screen, ruled rows of at least 72px, generous touch targets (44px minimum everywhere, 56px for primary actions) for an iPad held in the hand. Type does the hierarchy work through weight and size inside one family, Bricolage Grotesque, from an 800-weight tightly tracked display down to a 400 body.

Dark mode is the same notebook under a desk lamp at night: navy paper, light ink, and the highlighters keep dark ink on top so a marked word always reads as a marked word.
keyCharacteristics: Squared-paper background (24px grid) on every full screen, including the full-screen read-aloud stage.
One ink colour for type, rules, borders and the primary button.
Highlighter yellow, green and pink are state colours only.
Ruled lists (2px top rule, 1.5px row rules) instead of cards.
The highlighter swipe, animated left to right, marks the right answer, solutions and the line being read aloud.

rules.name: The Marker Means Something Rule
rules.body: Yellow is current or selected, green is right, pink is wrong. A marker colour never appears without that meaning, and never as a background for a section or card.

rules.name: The Dark Ink On Markers Rule
rules.body: Text on any full-strength marker is always on-highlight ink (#1d2433 light, #121722 dark), in both themes.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (400 / 600 / 700 / 800) and size inside Bricolage Grotesque. No second family.

rules.name: The Tight Big Type Rule
rules.body: Anything 1.5rem and up is set 800 with negative tracking (-0.025em to -0.04em); counts and scores use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Cast Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from ink lines and borders. A shadow is reserved for controls that float over scrolling content.

dos: Do set every full screen on the squared-paper grid (24px, grid-line colour).
Do draw structure with ink: 2px borders on interactive boxes, a 2px top rule and 1.5px row rules on lists.
Do keep text on full-strength markers in on-highlight ink, in both themes.
Do use the highlighter swipe for a right answer, a revealed solution or the line being read, and respect reduced motion.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and primary actions at 56px.
Do define every new colour in both light and dark token sets.
donts: Don't use marker yellow, green or pink as decoration or as a section background; each means current, right or wrong.
Don't wrap drills or content in tinted, shadowed cards; use ruled rows.
Don't add shadows to anything that does not float over scrolling content.
Don't introduce a second typeface or emoji tiles and mascots inside the interface.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph characters as icons; add a line SVG to the inline set.
